import type { Command, CommandErrorOptions, ExitResult, RunResult } from '@argvia/core'
import { argument, CommandError, defineCommand, exit, option, run } from '@argvia/core'
import { runMain } from '@argvia/node'

function expectType<Value>(value: Value): void {
  void value
}

const command: Command = defineCommand({
  args: [argument.string('action', { required: true })],
  options: { items: option.string({ flag: '--item', multiple: true }) },
  passthrough: true,
  run({ args, options, passthrough }) {
    expectType<string>(args.action)
    expectType<string[]>(options.items)
    expectType<readonly string[]>(passthrough)
    // @ts-expect-error 核心包推导的上下文不包含未声明参数
    expectType(args.missing)
    return args.action
  },
})

const app = defineCommand({ commands: { run: command }, defaultCommand: 'run' })
expectType<Promise<void>>(runMain(app))
expectType<Promise<RunResult>>(run(app, { argv: ['run', 'ready'] }))

// @ts-expect-error 终端适配与核心包共用命令键约束
defineCommand({ commands: { run: command }, defaultCommand: 'missing' })

// @ts-expect-error 进程适配器只接受核心包创建的命令
runMain({ name: 'unregistered' })

const completion: ExitResult = exit(7)
expectType<number>(completion.exitCode)
const exiting = defineCommand({ run: async () => completion })
expectType<Promise<void>>(runMain(exiting))
// @ts-expect-error 显式退出码必须是数字
exit('7')
// @ts-expect-error 普通对象不具备退出结果品牌
const ordinary: ExitResult = { exitCode: 7 }

const errorOptions: CommandErrorOptions = { exitCode: 2 }
const expectedFailure = new CommandError('配置无效', errorOptions)
const failing = defineCommand({ run() { throw expectedFailure } })
expectType<Promise<void>>(runMain(failing))
expectType<number>(expectedFailure.exitCode)
// @ts-expect-error 预期失败码必须是数字
new CommandError('配置无效', { exitCode: '2' })
